description: Get counts of graded, ungraded and not-submitted submissions for an assignment. Read-only. Often instructor-only, so students may get a permission error.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: get_submission_summary
title: Get Submission Summary
